name: 10304 · Staten Island, NY
findings: ZIP 10304 (Staten Island) has 148 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10304 (Staten Island) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10304 (Staten Island) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
